evidence_snippets: Initiate replication of a source VM To initiate replication of a source VM, follow these steps: Open the Migrate to Virtual Machines page in the Google Cloud console: Go to the Migrate to Virtual Machines page Select the VM Disk Migrations tab.

To switch from disk migration to VM migration, follow these steps: Open the Migrate to Virtual Machines page in the Google Cloud console: Go to the Migrate to Virtual Machines page Select the VM Disk Migrations tab.

To set the replication interval, perform the following steps: Open the Migrate to Virtual Machines page in the Google Cloud console: Go to the Migrate to Virtual Machines page Select the VM Disk Migrations tab.
